description: Use this when the user wants activity diagram text checked without a drawing, for example "is my flow valid?" or "which steps are not reachable?". Takes the same diagram text as make_activity_diagram. Returns ready true or false; when a line breaks the grammar or a block is not closed, the line number, the token and the reason; otherwise the counts, the steps with their block path, steps that are not reachable (found by a breadth-first search from the start), and empty branches. Does not draw the diagram or make files.
name: check_activity_diagram
title: Check activity diagram text
